policy.score_rule: Rubric anchors determine proposed scores; quota labels never lower or raise gold scores.
policy.text_rule: When a target response profile was inconsistent with rubric-correct scoring, the response text was rewritten instead of forcing the score.
policy.needs_review_rule: Borderline alone does not imply needs_review. Escalation is gold only when the available evidence cannot support reliable scoring.
policy.speaking_rule: Synthetic speaking records are transcript-only. Audio delivery criteria are removed from synthetic canonical rubrics rather than hallucinated.
policy.verification_rule: Synthetic pilot data is labeled ai_verified with verification_source=ai; teacher_verified is reserved for genuinely human-verified data.

next_action: Materialize Wave 1 into canonical dataset/records as ai_verified, using source -> recalibration -> second-pass AI override precedence. Then run quality/split gates before Wave 2.
